scheme_name: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department-Incentive/Award of Prizes
other_conditions: The beneficiary must have secured the highest marks in the 10th or 12th standard examinations within the district.
One prize is awarded to a boy and one to a girl per district.
Eligibility category noted in source: Adi Dravidar
Eligibility category noted in source: Tribal
Eligibility category noted in source: Adi Dravidar (converted to Christianity)
benefits_summary: Cash prizes of up to ₹3,000 are awarded to top‑scoring students in 10th and 12th standards.
